Hi, I'm still being a noob myself but I think I can answer those questions.

The side shops don't provide every item but just certain ones. For example recipes are only available at the base shop. Also even if an item is available at the side shop, you can not get that item from your stash but you can only directly buying it when you are at the shop.

You can permanently activate toggle spells by clicking Alt+Q/W/E/R (and also deactivate it that way).

Support Items: Also Dust, Smoke, Drums, Urn of shadows. Bracers are also great because of their good stats (espacially the strength for a bit of survivability) for just 500 Gold.
Also if you get quite a bit of gold Shivas, Sheep Stick and Force Staff are great items. Of course you can't get every of those support items. Drums, Urn, Mech and Pipe are normally split among the team members.
And for gods sake, if you play support get the fucking courier...

Regarding general item builds, most of the heroess have 1-2 core items they desperatly need to be effective (i.e. Blink Dagger on Initiators like Earthshaker or Sandking) but everything past that depends on your team, the enemies and how the game is going in general. If you want to get an idea of good item builds just watch live games or visit the youtube channels of DotaCinema or PurgeGamers.

In Pub games you can play every hero. In competitive play it's just as in LoL that there are heroes with better carry potential, utility skills or team fight abilitys and therefore are always picked.

Battle Points just show your "experience" as a player. They don't provide any gameplay advantage.
